sections.title: A family tradition *since 1985*

image.alt: The Bobby’s BBQ sign on a log wall, established 1985

body: Bobby’s Bar-B-Q was established in 1985 by Bobby Sr. and Barbara Griffin. More than forty years later, Bobby Jr. proudly carries on the family tradition of Southern-style Bar-B-Q in a charming, casual atmosphere.
We’ve built our name on hickory-smoked barbecue and the cooking that has kept guests coming back through the years: chopped pork, ribs, chicken and Southern sides on a classic buffet.

sections.title: Parties *and catering*
sections.intro: Birthdays, baby showers, holiday parties, rehearsal dinners, reunions and corporate events: we’ll handle the food while you enjoy your guests.

columns.title: Private parties
items: Four dining spaces, including the Horsecreek Room
A casual setting that’s still nice enough for photos and speeches

columns.title: On the catering menu
items: Pork, chicken (BBQ or fried) and ribs
Hash and rice, mac and cheese, green beans

items.a: Yes, and we recommend booking ahead. Call (803) 593-5900 to reserve a table.
Thursday to Saturday, 11 am to 8:30 pm, and Sunday 11 am to 3 pm, with an expanded buffet.

items.q: Are drinks included in the buffet?
items.a: Not with the adult buffet. The child’s buffet includes a drink and dessert.

items.q: Can you cater a big event?
items.a: Yes: pick-up, delivery or fully staffed, for up to 2,000 guests.

sections.text: Book a private room or catering for your next gathering.
